articles.title: HCA Healthcare Q3 2026 Earnings Beat Estimates as Revenue Rises to $19.85 Billion
articles.excerpt: Adjusted EPS rose 3.7% to $7.22 on revenue of $19.849 billion as admissions grew 3%; an uninsured payer shift cut pretax income by about $400 million, and 2027 earnings were signaled flat.
articles.nri_angle: HCA is the largest US for-profit hospital operator, so its admissions, uninsured-care costs and pricing shape hospital access and bills for Indian-American families across 19 states.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Coca-Cola Q3 2026 Earnings Beat Estimates, Revenue Rises 7% and Guidance Raised
articles.excerpt: Comparable EPS rose 11% to $0.91 on net revenues of $13.4 billion as global volume grew 5%, led by India, China, Mexico and Brazil; Coca-Cola lifted its 2026 EPS and free cash flow outlook.
articles.image_caption: The Coca-Cola Tower in Atlanta, the company's headquarters. Coca-Cola beat Q3 2026 estimates as revenue rose 7%.
articles.nri_angle: India was one of Coca-Cola's leading volume markets in the quarter, with its top brands there delivering double-digit growth — a direct read on consumer demand in India.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Boeing Q3 2026 Results: Revenue Rises 4% as Net Loss Narrows Sharply
articles.excerpt: Revenue rose to $24.188 billion and the net loss narrowed to $116 million from $5.339 billion a year ago; core loss of $0.34 per share missed estimates as Commercial Airplanes stayed unprofitable.
articles.image_caption: Boeing's headquarters in Arlington, Virginia. Boeing's Q3 2026 revenue rose 4% as its net loss narrowed sharply.
articles.nri_angle: Boeing's delivery pace and backlog affect Indian carriers' fleet growth and US-India air capacity, and its defense wins shape a major US aerospace employer for Indian-American engineers.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: L&T Profit Jumps 33% to Rs 5,202 Crore on Record Order Inflow
articles.excerpt: Larsen & Toubro's second-quarter profit rose 33% to Rs 5,202 crore as revenue grew 16%, but a flat EBITDA squeezed margins to 8.7% — a scale-versus-profitability split investors will weigh against a record Rs 1.47 lakh crore order intake.
articles.nri_angle: L&T is a core holding in many NRI India portfolios; its record order book signals infrastructure spending that flows through to engineering and construction employment.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: TCS and Infosys AI Revenue Crosses 10 Percent, Challenging SaaSpocalypse Fears
articles.excerpt: TCS annualised AI revenue hit $3.1 billion and Infosys AI grew 29% in Q2 FY27, even as overall growth stayed modest and Infosys cut guidance to 1-2%.
articles.nri_angle: AI implementation demand at TCS and Infosys reshapes hiring and career paths for Indian technology professionals in India and abroad.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: India's Top Six IT Firms Shed 24,422 Engineering Roles in One Year
articles.excerpt: Exits of about 92,000 outpaced hiring of 68,000 at TCS, Infosys, HCLTech, Wipro, Tech Mahindra and LTIMindtree, Xpheno data show, as firms left vacant seats unfilled.
articles.image_caption: YouTube / The Indian Insight
articles.nri_angle: The slowdown hits maintenance and support roles held by many Indian professionals abroad and the fresher hiring pipeline families in India rely on.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Silver Has Crashed 53% From Its January Peak and Gold Is Down 26%: What Broke the Rally
articles.excerpt: Silver fell from about $117-$121 an ounce in January to around $54 by October 23, while gold dropped 26% from its January record — a reversal driven by rate-hike expectations, higher energy prices and margin-driven selling.
articles.nri_angle: Families who bought gold and silver at January highs for Diwali and weddings are now holding losses of a quarter to a half on paper.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Infosys, TCS and Other IT Stocks Fall Up to 3% as Anthropic's IPO Filing Reprices AI
articles.excerpt: Indian IT shares fell up to 3% on Tuesday as Anthropic's Nasdaq filing under the ticker ANT — $16.3 billion in half-year revenue and huge losses — lifted global AI and chip stocks while pressuring legacy services firms.
articles.nri_angle: Indian IT stocks are core holdings for many diaspora investors and employers for H-1B professionals, so the AI repricing hits both portfolios and jobs.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Infosys Shares Fall 4% After Q2: Brokerages Split Between Buy And Hold
articles.excerpt: UBS sees 23% upside to Rs 1,415 while Goldman Sachs targets Rs 1,000 as Infosys cuts FY27 guidance to 1-2% after its September quarter
articles.image_caption: Infosys headquarters campus in Bengaluru. Infosys shares fell 4% after Q2 results as brokerages split between Buy and Hold ratings.
articles.nri_angle: Infosys is one of the most widely held Indian IT stocks among diaspora investors, so the split in brokerage targets after its guidance cut directly affects their India portfolios.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Verizon Q3 2026 Earnings Beat Estimates as Phone Adds Hit Five-Year High; Guidance Raised
articles.excerpt: Adjusted EPS rose 8.3% to $1.31 on revenue of $34.31 billion; Verizon added 406,000 postpaid phone subscribers and lifted its full-year EPS outlook to $5.04-$5.06.
articles.nri_angle: Verizon is one of the largest US carriers for Indian-American households, so its wireless pricing, churn and broadband expansion shape connectivity costs for diaspora families.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Indian Overseas Bank Profit Jumps 56% as It Targets $500 Million Fundraise
articles.excerpt: IOB posted Q2 net profit of Rs 1,912 crore on 26% growth in net interest income, improved NPAs to 1.19%, and said $250 million of its planned $500 million overseas borrowing is already finalised.
articles.image_caption: Ajay Kumar srivastava with Deputy Chief Minister of Uttar Pradesh.
articles.image_credit: Photo: Ajay Srivastava.2026 via Wikimedia Commons (CC0)
articles.nri_angle: A stronger IOB result and a $500 million overseas fundraise are relevant to diaspora investors in Indian bank stocks and to NRI depositors using FCNR(B) products.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Dow, S&P and Nasdaq Rise as Oil Retreats and Tesla Jumps on Upgrade
articles.excerpt: Stocks climbed Monday, Oct. 26, as cooling oil prices and Anthropic's IPO filing lifted technology shares ahead of the Fed decision and a heavy week of big-tech earnings.
articles.image_caption: The New York Stock Exchange. U.S. stocks rose on Monday as oil retreated and Tesla jumped after a Barclays upgrade.
articles.nri_angle: Straight U.S. and global markets wrap; index, oil and Tesla moves and the Wednesday Fed decision affect U.S. brokerage and retirement portfolios broadly.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Gold Retreats From Record Highs as Jewellers Bet on Diwali Demand
articles.excerpt: Prices are down nearly 20% from the January record to Rs 14,315 per gram, but IBJA expects October volumes to fall 11% year on year as lightweight designs and old-gold exchange sustain value sales ahead of Dhanteras and Diwali.
articles.image_caption: Gold crystals (file photo)
articles.nri_angle: Gold buying for Dhanteras and Diwali is a shared ritual for diaspora families, and the price correction affects both jewellery budgets and remittance-season purchases.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: MakeMyTrip Returns to Profit as Domestic Travel Offsets Weak Rupee
articles.excerpt: The Nasdaq-listed travel company posted a $1.8 million profit in Q2 FY27 on revenue of $235.2 million, with bus ticketing and hotels offsetting subdued international long-haul demand and a roughly 10% rupee depreciation.
articles.nri_angle: MakeMyTrip's results matter to Indian travellers and diaspora investors tracking India's outbound and domestic travel demand on Nasdaq.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Oil Prices Dip but Hold Above $100 as Middle East Supply Threats Mount
articles.excerpt: Brent fell to $114.60 and U.S. crude to $101.13 early Monday after a 6% weekly Brent gain, as Houthi attacks on Saudi facilities and 28 Hormuz tanker attacks this month kept the risk premium intact.
articles.image_caption: An oil pumpjack (file photo)
articles.nri_angle: Oil holding above $100 keeps fuel, freight and import costs elevated for both U.S. households and India, the world's major crude importer in the diaspora's home economy.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

data_cards.card_title: Attacks in the Strait of Hormuz

articles.title: Rupee Rally Hits Roadblock as Oil and Outflows Test RBI Defence
articles.excerpt: The rupee slipped to 94.98 on Monday as Brent at $114.48, importer hedging and a $75-80 billion RBI defence left the currency pinned near its 95-per-dollar line.
articles.nri_angle: A rupee pinned near 94.98 per dollar directly affects remittance value and India-linked costs for the diaspora, with $1,000 worth about Rs 94,980 before fees at Monday's early rate.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Sensex Falls 489 Points as Infosys Guidance Cut and Oil Hit Markets
articles.excerpt: The Nifty slipped below 22,500 on Monday, October 26, as Infosys cut fiscal 2027 growth guidance to 1%-2%, Brent crude held near $110 and investors waited for the Federal Reserve decision.
articles.image_caption: The Bombay Stock Exchange building in Mumbai (file photo). The Sensex fell 489 points after Infosys cut its guidance and oil prices rose.
articles.nri_angle: Diaspora investors holding Infosys and Indian index exposure face a stock down 28.2% in 2026 after its weakest guidance in seven years, with broker targets split between Rs 1,110 and Rs 1,415.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: CPI(M) and Unions Challenge IDBI Sale to Fairfax as Staff Set November Strike
articles.excerpt: The ₹52,878-crore sale of 60.72% to Canada's Fairfax would be the largest foreign investment in an Indian bank; the government says employee terms and pensions are contractually protected.
articles.nri_angle: Fairfax is led by Indian-origin Canadian billionaire Prem Watsa; NRI depositors with IDBI accounts face possible branch disruption on November 2-3.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

dates.event: IDBI Bank staff begin two-day nationwide strike against the Fairfax sale
Second day of the all-India strike; UFBU solidarity programmes

articles.title: US Midterms May Shift Market Sentiment, but Analysts See No Sustained Trend Reversal
articles.excerpt: With inflation at 3.7% and the Fed raising rates again, analysts quoted by Moneycontrol and asset managers say earnings, oil and the rate path, not the November 3 result, will set the market's direction.
articles.image_caption: The U.S. Capitol in Washington. Analysts say the November midterms may shift market sentiment but are unlikely to reverse the broader trend.
articles.nri_angle: The midterm result reaches Indian and diaspora portfolios through US yields and the dollar: a Fed pause would ease pressure on the rupee and Indian equities, while higher yields prolong foreign outflows.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Net FDI Into India Rises 44% to $13.8 Billion in April-August, RBI Data Show
articles.excerpt: Gross inflows of $54.9 billion and slower outward FDI lifted net FDI from $9.6 billion a year earlier, with services and manufacturing drawing about 73% of equity inflows.
articles.image_caption: The Reserve Bank of India tower in Mumbai. RBI data show net FDI into India rose 44% to $13.8 billion in April-August.
articles.nri_angle: Rising net FDI, led by US sources and services, tracks the same investment corridor that links diaspora capital and global capability centres to India's economy.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Zetwerk Lists at 5% Premium, Ends Debut 8% Below Issue Price as Early Backers Book 38x
articles.excerpt: Shares opened at Rs 159 against a Rs 151 issue price but closed at Rs 138.30 in Peak XV Partners' 30th portfolio listing, a Rs 5,012 crore IPO subscribed 3.1 times.
articles.nri_angle: Zetwerk's debut is a benchmark Indian industrial-tech listing for diaspora investors tracking India exposure through GIFT City and NRI investment routes.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Government Weighs Cutting Stakes in Four PSU Banks to 75% After IDBI Sale
articles.excerpt: Central Bank of India, UCO Bank, Punjab & Sind Bank and Indian Overseas Bank could see government holdings cut to 75% within a year to meet SEBI public shareholding norms, The Economic Times reported.
articles.image_caption: State Bank of India, one of India's public-sector banks. The government is weighing cutting its stakes in four other PSU banks to 75%.
articles.nri_angle: The stake cuts affect listed Indian public sector banks held by NRI and diaspora investors, with larger public floats expected in four lenders.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Freight Now Adds Up to $40 a Barrel to Delivered Cost of Oil
articles.excerpt: Tanker costs have risen sevenfold in a year as Hormuz war risk, ship-to-ship transfers and scarce vessels add as much as $40.50 per barrel on U.S.-to-Asia voyages, squeezing refiners and rerouting global crude flows.
articles.image_caption: The VLCC Aktaia, an oil tanker. Freight for shipping crude on very large crude carriers has risen sharply, adding up to about $40 a barrel to delivered costs.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: India Smartphone Shipments Fall 20% to Decade Low in Q3
articles.excerpt: Counterpoint Research says record-high memory prices pushed up device costs, sub-Rs 20,000 shipments fell 47%, and Samsung reclaimed the top spot with a 17% share.
articles.image_caption: An illuminated Samsung sign is pictured on a building. Samsung reclaimed the top spot in India's smartphone market in Q3 2026 with a 17% share, according to Counterpoint Research.
articles.nri_angle: India's handset slump signals weaker mass-market consumer demand and higher upgrade costs for families buying phones in India.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: American Express Profit Jumps 28%, Raises Outlook, Cuts 3,500 Jobs
articles.excerpt: Affluent customers kept the $895 Platinum Card and spent through the quarter, lifting revenue to a record $20.1 billion — while AmEx booked a $336 million charge to trim 5% of its workforce.
articles.nri_angle: AmEx results signal the health of affluent US consumer spending that shapes portfolios and premium card economics for Indian-American households.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Sensex, Nifty Fall for Fourth Session as Brent Crude Hits $114
articles.excerpt: Benchmarks lost 2.2% and 2.4% this week as crude surged on Saudi supply fears and foreign investors sold Rs 3,458.70 crore in a single session, while small-caps posted their worst week in 20 months.
articles.image_caption: The Bombay Stock Exchange building in Mumbai. The Sensex fell for a fourth straight session as Brent crude rose to $114.
articles.nri_angle: Diaspora investors holding Indian equities and mutual funds face a fourth straight down session driven by crude at $114 and record October foreign outflows, with IPO refund liquidity the key near-term support.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Infosys Cuts FY27 Growth Outlook Despite Strong AI Revenue Surge
articles.excerpt: Infosys trimmed FY27 constant-currency growth guidance to 1-2% after Q2 revenue beat estimates, even as large deal wins hit $5.2 billion and AI revenue jumped 29% quarter on quarter.
articles.nri_angle: Infosys is a widely held stock among Indian and diaspora investors, and its guidance signals how US client spending is shaping Indian IT employment and earnings.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Swiggy Shares Plunge 17% to 52-Week Low as Instamart Losses Widen
articles.excerpt: Swiggy fell to Rs 174.90 after Q2 FY27 results showed Instamart's adjusted EBITDA loss widening to Rs 895 crore, prompting target cuts from Citi, CLSA, Nomura, HSBC and others even as most kept their ratings.
articles.nri_angle: Indian-listed platform stocks are a common holding for NRI investors tracking India's consumer internet sector; the target cuts reset expectations for the whole quick-commerce segment.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Tonbo Imaging Shares Jump 66% on Debut After IPO Subscribed 136 Times
articles.excerpt: The Bengaluru defence electronics maker listed at Rs 1,162 against a Rs 700 issue price, in an entirely offer-for-sale IPO that brings the company itself no proceeds.
articles.nri_angle: NRI investors holding Indian defence stocks through NRE demat accounts get a listing gain, but the OFS structure and FY26 profit decline set the diligence bar for holding.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

dates.event: Public issue closes; subscribed about 136 times
Shares list on BSE and NSE at about 66% premium

articles.title: Record Gold Prices Are Changing What Diwali Shoppers Buy, Not Whether They Buy
articles.excerpt: Toronto shoppers are choosing smaller pieces and spending more cautiously, while buyers in India shift to lightweight jewellery, coins and old-gold exchanges as prices stay near record highs.
articles.image_caption: Four thin gold bangles (file photo). Diwali buyers are shifting to lighter pieces as gold prices stay near record levels, jewellers and the World Gold Council say.
articles.nri_angle: Diaspora families in Toronto are keeping the Diwali gold tradition by buying lighter pieces, coins and exchanges instead of heavy jewellery at record prices.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Treasury Drops Venezuela From Outbound Investment Restriction List in New Proposal
articles.excerpt: Proposed COINS Act rules keep China, Russia, Cuba, Iran and North Korea as countries of concern, ban AI deals, and open comments through December 7.
articles.image_caption: The US Treasury Building in Washington. Treasury proposed outbound investment rules on October 22 that drop Venezuela from the countries-of-concern list.
articles.nri_angle: US-based investors and funds with emerging-market and technology exposure need to track which outbound deals now require Treasury notification.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Nasdaq Tumbles 2.6% as Oil Surge and AI Spending Fears Hit Stocks
articles.excerpt: The Nasdaq suffered its worst day since June as Brent topped $113, Meta slid on AI costs, and investors fled to Treasuries.
articles.image_caption: The Nasdaq MarketSite in New York. The Nasdaq Composite fell 2.6% on October 22 as oil prices surged and AI spending fears hit stocks.
articles.nri_angle: US equity and oil moves directly affect diaspora retirement and brokerage portfolios concentrated in mega-cap technology stocks.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Infosys ADR Jumps 3.7% as GuruFocus Still Sees Deep Undervaluation
articles.excerpt: Infosys closed at $13.22 in New York even as GuruFocus puts fair value at $18.97, with Q2 results on October 23 set to test the valuation case.
articles.image_caption: Infosys headquarters in Bengaluru. The company's American depositary receipts rose 3.7% on October 22.
articles.nri_angle: Infosys is a widely held Indian IT stock for diaspora investors in both ADR and NSE form, so its valuation and guidance affect household portfolios.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Gold Falls Below $4,100 as Oil Shock Lifts Fed Hike Bets
articles.excerpt: Gold dropped more than 2% to around $4,053, its lowest since August 4, as Brent above $112 kept inflation fears alive ahead of the Fed's October 27-28 meeting.
articles.nri_angle: For diaspora gold buyers watching prices in dollars per ounce, the slide below $4,100 is a Fed-and-oil story, not a safe-haven story, with $4,000 as the next level to watch.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

items.label: Chance of Fed Rate Hike in December

articles.title: Honeywell Q3 Earnings: Adjusted EPS Jumps 34% to $2.27 as Margins Expand; 2026 Outlook Raised
articles.excerpt: Sales of $5.0 billion grew 7% organically in the first full quarter after the Aerospace spin-off; segment profit rose 23% and backlog reached nearly $19 billion.
articles.image_caption: Honeywell's Charlotte headquarters. The industrial conglomerate raised its 2026 outlook after third-quarter adjusted earnings beat expectations.
articles.nri_angle: Honeywell is one of the largest industrial employers of Indian-origin engineers in the US and runs major technology centers in India, so its automation backlog and hiring demand are a useful signal for diaspora professionals in industrial tech.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Procter & Gamble Q1 Earnings Beat Estimates on 4% Sales Growth; Sales Outlook Raised
articles.excerpt: Core EPS of $2.00 topped the $1.89 consensus as net sales rose 4% to $23.28 billion; P&G raised its fiscal 2027 all-in sales growth outlook to 2–4% while holding EPS guidance.
articles.image_caption: A Procter & Gamble facility in Kobe, Japan. The consumer-goods maker beat first-quarter earnings estimates on 4 percent sales growth and raised its sales outlook.
articles.nri_angle: P&G is led by India-born CEO Shailesh Jejurikar, and its brands — Tide, Pampers, Gillette, Pantene, Oral-B — are staples in Indian-American households, so its pricing and margin outlook signals household-goods inflation ahead.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Comcast Q3 Earnings Beat Estimates as Peacock Turns Profitable Again; Broadband Losses Widen
articles.excerpt: Adjusted EPS of $1.07 topped the $0.98 consensus on revenue of $29.3 billion; wireless added a record 368,000 lines while domestic broadband lost 144,000 customers.
articles.image_caption: The Comcast Center in Philadelphia. Comcast beat third-quarter estimates as Peacock returned to profitability.
articles.nri_angle: Xfinity is the largest US broadband provider, so Comcast's pricing and wireless bundles shape what Indian-American households pay for connectivity, while Peacock and Universal's film slate are a growing share of what diaspora families watch.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: RBI Minutes: Rate Cuts Off the Table as Inflation Risks Spread Beyond Food and Fuel
articles.excerpt: Minutes of the RBI's October meeting show a unanimous 25-basis-point hike to 5.50% — the first in nearly four years — and a 4-2 split on shifting to 'calibrated tightening,' with Governor Sanjay Malhotra saying the next move can only be a hike or a pause.
articles.nri_angle: For NRIs with floating-rate loans or deposits in India: no rate relief is coming in the near term, deposit rates should hold, and markets now price more than 100 basis points of further hikes over 12 months.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Yes Bank Faces Rs 5,217 Crore Pro Forma Hit After Supreme Court AT-1 Ruling
articles.excerpt: Yes Bank says recognising the Supreme Court verdict that quashed its Rs 8,415 crore AT-1 bond write-off would have turned its September-quarter profit into a Rs 5,217 crore loss and cut its CET-1 ratio to 11.4%. Japan's SMBC, which now owns 24.9%, bought in while the case was pending.
articles.nri_angle: NRI holders of Indian bank paper face the same question as domestic investors: how a revived 2020 liability is shared between old shareholders, bondholders and the new foreign owner.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Swiggy Loss Narrows Year on Year, Widens Sequentially in Q2
articles.excerpt: Swiggy's revenue rose 36.1% year on year to Rs 7,571 crore in Q2 FY27. Its Rs 922 crore loss was smaller than a year ago but larger than Q1, as Instamart losses offset record food delivery profit.
articles.nri_angle: Swiggy's results matter to global investors tracking India's listed consumer-tech sector, where food delivery profit is now funding a costly quick-commerce expansion.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Adani Green Shares Fall 4% After Q2 Results as Brokers Split on Grid Bottlenecks
articles.excerpt: Profit rose 15% to Rs 673 crore and power-supply EBITDA jumped 51%, but weak grid availability knocked the stock; Jefferies kept a Buy at Rs 1,695 while JM Financial held Add at Rs 1,374.
articles.nri_angle: For NRI investors holding Indian renewables, the quarter's split verdict — record generation economics versus transmission delays — is the story to track.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Jio IPO Draws Rs 69,800 Crore in Bids on Day One, Subscribed 3.16 Times
articles.excerpt: Jio Platforms' Rs 30,213-crore issue, India's largest ever, was fully subscribed in 100 minutes on October 21, led by institutional bids at 9.42 times the QIB quota, with retail at 0.73 times ahead of the October 23 close.
articles.image_caption: The Jio LYF building. Reliance Jio's IPO drew Rs 69,800 crore in bids on day one, subscribed 3.16 times.
articles.nri_angle: Diaspora investors with Indian demat accounts can still bid before the October 23 close; allotment is expected October 26, with a 12-share lot costing Rs 13,428 at the upper band.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

dates.event: Listing scheduled on BSE and NSE

articles.title: Sensex, Nifty Fall for Third Session as Crude Tops $110 on Saudi Attacks
articles.excerpt: The Sensex opened 0.5% lower at 73,343.3 and the Nifty fell 0.54% to 22,687.75 on Thursday, October 22, as Brent above $110 stoked inflation fears and every NSE sector traded in the red.
articles.nri_angle: Diaspora investors holding Indian equities face a third straight down session driven by crude above $110; Sensex support at 73,200-73,500 and possible further RBI hikes are the concrete levels and risks to track.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Meta Q3 Earnings: Revenue Jumps 26% to $64.6 Billion as $9.9 Billion Legal Charge Cuts Profit
articles.excerpt: Adjusted EPS of $7.40 beat the $6.52 estimate; reported EPS of $3.83 reflects the teen mental-health settlement charge, and AI capex pushed free cash flow negative.
articles.nri_angle: India is Meta's largest market by users across Facebook, Instagram and WhatsApp, so its ad growth, AI spending and US legal settlements shape the platforms diaspora families use daily to stay connected.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: International Business Machines (IBM) Q3 Earnings Beat Estimates as Software Revenue Jumps 8%
articles.excerpt: Revenue of $17.1 billion and operating EPS of $2.95 both topped consensus; IBM raised its full-year free cash flow outlook.
articles.image_caption: IBM headquarters in Armonk, New York. IBM's Q3 earnings beat estimates as software revenue rose 8%.
articles.nri_angle: IBM is one of the largest employers of Indian-origin technology professionals in the US, and its Red Hat and data-software growth points to where enterprise AI hiring demand is heading.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: AT&T Q3 Earnings Beat Estimates as Fiber Adds Hit a Record; 2026 Outlook Raised
articles.excerpt: Adjusted EPS of $0.65 topped the $0.61 consensus on revenue of $32.32 billion; a $2.6 billion Mexico impairment cut reported EPS to $0.13.
articles.image_caption: AT&T's Spirit of Communications sculpture outside its headquarters in Dallas, Texas. AT&T's Q3 earnings beat estimates as fiber additions hit a record.
articles.nri_angle: AT&T is one of the largest US carriers for Indian-American households, and its fiber and fixed-wireless pricing shapes what diaspora families pay for home connectivity and international calling bundles.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Carmakers Bank on Diwali as Maruti Bookings Climb to 2.7 Lakh After Dussehra
articles.excerpt: Maruti Suzuki retail sales rose 35% between Ganesh Chaturthi and Dussehra with SUV sales doubling, while FADA's Navratri registrations show a more mixed industry picture distorted by a shorter festival window.
articles.nri_angle: Festive car buying in India peaks at Dhanteras and Diwali, including purchases diaspora families fund or make for relatives in India; Maruti's 2.7 lakh backlog affects delivery timing for those buyers.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: M&M Financial Profit Climbs 61% Consolidated; Eternal Profit Surges 92% but Misses Estimates
articles.excerpt: M&M Financial's consolidated Q2 profit rose to Rs 910.73 crore with improving asset quality, while Eternal's Rs 125 crore profit nearly doubled but fell short of the Rs 271 crore analysts expected as Blinkit expansion spending weighed.
articles.image_caption: Eternal headquarters. Eternal, parent of Zomato and Blinkit, reported profit up 92% in Q2 but missed estimates as Blinkit expansion costs weighed.
articles.nri_angle: For diaspora investors tracking Indian consumer and financial names, Eternal's Blinkit spending and M&M Financial's asset-quality trend are the two monitorables from this results day.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Mid-Caps Outgrow Large-Caps in Q2 as Persistent Revenue Jumps 20%, TCS Profit Rises 15%
articles.excerpt: Persistent Systems posted 20% dollar revenue growth and a 26th straight sequential rise in Q2 FY27, while TCS delivered 15% profit growth and Wipro's profit slipped — with Infosys still to report on October 23.
articles.nri_angle: Diaspora investors in Indian IT ADRs and India funds face a growth-versus-stability choice between faster-growing mid-caps at premium valuations and dividend-paying large-caps.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

items.text: Persistent revenue up 20.0% year on year.
Persistent net profit fell 25.4% due to acquisition costs.
Coforge shares similar growth profile as Persistent.

articles.title: India Inc Festive Revenue Holds Up as Margins Shrink in Q2
articles.excerpt: ICRA expects Q2 revenue growth of 13-15% on festive stocking, but operating margins to contract 100-150 basis points, while Mint consensus sees Nifty EBITDA falling 9.3% despite 18.6% revenue growth.

sources.label: The Hindu BusinessLine - ICRA Q2 outlook

articles.nri_angle: For NRI investors holding India equities, Q2 separates revenue growth from earnings quality, with domestic consumption names better placed than export-linked sectors facing weak global demand.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Abbott to Spin Off Nutrition Unit, Cuts 2026 Sales Growth Outlook
articles.excerpt: Abbott will carve its $8.5 billion Nutrition business, home to Similac and Ensure, into a standalone public company by end-2027, as it lowers its 2026 sales growth forecast to about 6%.
articles.nri_angle: A major US healthcare restructuring with direct relevance for diaspora investors holding Abbott and for families who use Similac and Ensure products.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Antique Sees 17% Upside in Jio as Tariff Hike Holds the Key
articles.excerpt: Antique Stock Broking argues a 15% sector tariff hike could unlock about Rs 190 per share and push Jio's ARPU toward Rs 300, valuing the IPO at about 15.6 times EV/EBITDA.
articles.nri_angle: For NRI investors tracking Indian listings, Antique's call frames Jio's post-listing return as a tariff-execution bet, with ARPU toward Rs 300 as the measurable test.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Sensex Surges 695 Points as Nifty Reclaims 23,000 on IT Rally
articles.excerpt: Indian benchmarks rebounded on Wednesday, October 21, with Infosys and TCS leading an earnings-driven IT rally after Monday's sharp sell-off.
articles.image_caption: The Bombay Stock Exchange in Mumbai. The Sensex surged 695 points as the Nifty reclaimed 23,000 on an IT-led rally.
articles.nri_angle: NRI investors get the concrete levels and flows behind the bounce: FII selling of Rs 1,148 crore against DII buying of Rs 3,200 crore, with Nifty resistance at 23,150-23,200.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: US Pending Home Sales Fall 7.3% to Record Low as Mortgage Rates Hit 7.40%
articles.excerpt: The NAR index dropped to 66.0 in September, its lowest since the series began in 2001, as a jump in the 30-year mortgage rate from 6.66% in late August pushed buyers out in every region.
articles.nri_angle: Indian-American buyers active in US suburbs face 7.40% mortgage rates and less competition, with more price cuts and inventory for those who can still afford to buy.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: GE Aerospace Q3 Earnings Beat Estimates, Guidance Raised Across the Board
articles.excerpt: Adjusted EPS of $2.25 and a 49 percent jump in orders cap a strong quarter for the engine maker.
articles.image_caption: The GE Aerospace headquarters complex in Evendale, Ohio. The company beat Q3 estimates and raised guidance across the board.

articles.title: 3M Q3 Earnings Beat Estimates as Company Raises Full-Year Guidance
articles.excerpt: 3M posts adjusted EPS of $2.50 on $6.58 billion in sales and lifts its 2026 outlook.
articles.image_caption: 3M's corporate headquarters in Minnesota. The company beat Q3 earnings estimates and raised its full-year guidance.

articles.title: Netflix Q3 Earnings Beat on Profit, but Softer Guidance Hits the Stock
articles.excerpt: Revenue of $12.87 billion and a 34.6 percent operating margin top the quarter; outlook and ad forecast disappoint.
